items.text: Receiving evidence distinguishes qualified/current, absent, stale, partial and failing material, shows the available source/standing/coverage/freshness information and names unsupported conclusions; unavailable values remain visibly limited rather than fresh, complete or authoritative. Verified by VER-001.

verification.text: Inspect App receiving behavior and presentation against the accepted limitation clauses; compare supplied source identities, standing, coverage/freshness and missing metadata with displayed results for qualified/current and each limited/absent condition. Use the relevant agreed connector meanings, recording any undecided comparison as pending.

items.text: Each absence/staleness/partiality/failure case exposes the affected question's source-file route and gaps, including total absence with no response. A missing underlying source yields an explicit unresolved need and responsible route, not a fabricated answer or an assertion that file access supplied authority. Verified by VER-002.

verification.text: Follow the same affected question through absent, stale, partial and failing fixtures, including no response and unavailable underlying sources. Inspect the visible source route, locate the cited files/revisions when available, and compare conclusions/gaps and the responsible recovery path with their source support.

items.text: Failure and reconstruction evidence contains no unsupported empty-work, readiness or permission conclusion and retains separate execution, proposal-acceptance, checking, approval and professional-reliance subjects/actors/evidence. Evidence of one act supplies neither another act nor an invented prerequisite ordering. Verified by VER-003.

verification.text: Inspect failure and recovered records for inferred empty work, readiness or permission. Compare each execution/acceptance/checking/approval/reliance assertion with its actual subject, actor and evidence, including cases with only one act evidenced and others unknown. Check that applicable prerequisites are sourced and no generic acceptance-before-other-acts dependency is introduced.

items.text: The documented recovery route can be followed from ordinary source files without PEC or later fleet software; it identifies agent discovery/comparison, manager review/integration and human cross-undertaking work and distinguishes prepared, performed and outstanding duties. Verified by VER-004.

verification.text: Walk the recovery document using only available project graphs, decisions, revisions and other source records, with PEC and later fleet views unavailable. Trace agent reconstruction, manager review/integration and human coordination assignments, then compare claimed performed duties with actual records; list any remaining source or actor input.

items.text: Independent-availability cases show PEC receiving with Domains absent, Domains receiving with PEC absent, both absent, and absent PEC with a stale Domains source. Each affected path retains its own limitations and missing inputs while independently supported work can proceed; neither delivery becomes a blanket v4 start condition. Verified by VER-005.

verification.text: Exercise the four independent-availability combinations in AC-005 against the receiving contracts or explicitly simulated equivalents. Compare each connector's limitation/recovery result, verify independent supported continuation and inspect that waiting questions keep their actual unsatisfied inputs and data-boundary constraints.

items.text: A later PEC join uses the exact coverage and qualification/release/App-adoption standing supplied by the App receiving owner, preserves source recovery for unsupported material and introduces no blanket restart gate. A prepared, unqualified, unreleased or unadopted case remains visibly limited, including when D108 acceptance is present. Verified by VER-006.

verification.text: Examine a file-route-to-PEC join with the App DEL-07-01 evidence account: compare declared coverage, current limitations, qualification, release and App adoption with the consumed envelope. Repeat with each prerequisite absent or unsupported and inspect continuation/source routing. Treat simulated joins as development evidence; actual adoption requires its own evidence, including any accepted provider limitations.

items.text: The fixture/evidence account binds its App candidate, source question and source/input identities, records checks against these criteria and distinguishes simulation from actual receiving operation. Missing external inputs and unexecuted checks remain explicit rather than passing or proving finished-product failure. Verified by VER-007.

verification.text: Audit fixture and execution records for candidate/source/input binding, same-question continuity, criterion coverage, performed outcomes, simulation labels and pending inputs. Compare them with V4-EXM-30's receiving/limited/absent examination, without claiming this local fixture set completes the separately owned joined connector witness.

items.text: The responsibility document, receiving paths and verification assertions preserve every excluded act in REQ-008 with its CLM-003 or CLM-005 owner, including the unresolved Domains allocation; the fallback slice neither takes over sibling/provider/human acts nor depends on a future fleet implementation to reconstruct files. Verified by VER-008.

verification.text: Review each excluded act in REQ-008 against the cited owner claims, accepted allocation and receiving code/documentation/test assertions. Check named App deliverable owners and the external/manager/human owners that deterministic ID matching cannot establish; inspect for invented Domains allocation, provider delivery, policy ruling or fleet prerequisite.
